clusters.name: title-helper
clusters.executionModeRationale: The helper defines the formatting, OSC, WT guard, logging, and test seams used by all runtime entry points. Build it first so subsequent wiring has a stable API.

clusters.name: lead-wiring
clusters.executionModeRationale: The assignment and SessionStart paths must share the same helper and title policy. Running this before the helper would create avoidable API churn.

clusters.name: release-docs
clusters.executionModeRationale: Version and changelog changes should be finalized after runtime behavior and smoke-test results are known.
